scope.preflight: 15 CPU-profile-ON flights, one per map/mode; separate diagnostic cohort
scope.validation5: 75 CPU-profile-OFF flights, five per map/mode; no retries pooled
scope.logs: attempt1 only; duplicate convenient .stack.log copies excluded
scope.claims: Finite-run observed records only; not a proof of population-level safety or a reproduction of the prior memory fault
scope.async_discard: Request not authorized for recovery release; not a failed flight or an Adaptive sensing switch
scope.callback_frequency: Actual instrumented callback counts divided by profiler report window; OFF odometry is receipt evidence, not producer FSM callback timing
scope.memory: Sampled combined FSM/frontend/simulator process RSS, not isolated planner memory
scope.postcommit_discard_reason: Final proof rejected; exact individual predicate is not recorded in this logging version, so the underlying reason is not inferred
